label: sections skip %% in strings, block comments and matrices, and comments fold
a section inside a block ends before the block end
sections inside a function end before its end
switch cases fold separately; else, elseif and catch do not fold
catch ends a section opened in the try clause
else ends a section opened in the if clause
otherwise ends a section opened in a case
functions without end close at the next function
a function without end ends at its last code line
a section after the last code line of a function without end spans the next function
a method named end does not close its function
an end(...) method declaration does not close the methods block
code:
classdef C
  methods (Hidden)
    e = end(a,k,n)
    disp(a)
  end
  methods
    function m(obj)
      x = 1;
    end
  end
end

label: an arguments block after a continued function signature
code:
function out = f(a, ...
    b)
arguments
  a double
  b double
end
out = a + b;
end

label: end inside indexing does not close a block
methods(...) inside an if is a call, not a block
code:
%% A
if x
  methods(obj)
end
%% B
y = 1;

label: properties(...) inside a function is a call, not a block
methods, properties and events in a script are not blocks
a shell escape line is not code
code:
%% A
!echo if
%% B
x = 1;

label: block comments and code break runs of comment lines
a section header breaks a run of comment lines
code:
% a
% b
%% Sec
% c
% d
x = 1;

label: one-line blocks do not fold
code:
%% A
if x, y = 1; end
for k = 1:3, z = k; end
%% B
q = 1;

Windows line endings
